headword: {全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}
gloss: full-speed sprint; running at full speed

definitions.gloss: full-speed sprint; running at full speed
definitions.explanation: Running as fast as one physically can, exerting maximum effort and speed.

examples.japanese: {全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}する。
{選手|せんしゅ}たちが{全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}でゴールを{目指|めざ}した。
examples.english: The athletes sprinted toward the goal at full speed.

examples.japanese: {終電|しゅうでん}に{間|ま}に{合|あ}うように{駅|えき}まで{全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}した。
examples.english: I sprinted to the station at full speed to catch the last train.

notes:
A compound of {全力|ぜんりょく} (full power) and {疾走|しっそう} (sprint, dash). Describes running as fast as physically possible. Used in both sports contexts and everyday situations where someone runs with maximum effort.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}する: to sprint at full speed
- {全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}で{駆|か}ける: to dash at full speed
- {全力疾走|ぜんりょくしっそう}で{逃|に}げる: to flee at full speed

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {疾走|しっそう}: sprint, dash — does not necessarily imply maximum effort
- {全速力|ぜんそくりょく}: full speed — often used adverbially ({全速力|ぜんそくりょく}で), describes the speed rather than the act of running
- ダッシュ: dash — more casual; often used for short bursts of speed
